notes.title: Update: polish and level pack 2!
notes.notes:
Polish

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/75a714967477fe1f97185cfacf9eb31b23335ed0.png

Based on the great input from players at game expo the game was polished, these parts were updated:


    helper to show which ordered point is supposed to be next
    better "not all required points passed" message timing
    fix of editor reload pointing to scan page
    level name shown while playing level
    info text in level with shadow to be better readable


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/39ec034dfc2007daada69adb0dbc2699d35f204f.png

I hope this will make the gameplay more pleasant!

Level pack 2

This time I've chosen the additive color theme so you can explore this mechanic more in the new 8 levels found in Extra Levels tab, enjoy! I hope they are challenging and fun at the same time.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/2d94ca106927e8c944990e041fdcd9e400676947.png

Happy puzzle solving and have a nice Easter!

notes.title: Free update: Level pack 1
notes.notes:
Today the game was expanded with 10 new levels. You can find them at the end of Extra levels tab! Levels are showing how just a slight change of rules can create interesting variations to the solution and change the overall difficulty.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/e08d19be7d0db3fbde6774eb1ffd2b6df023ad67.png

More updates like this are planned for the future. Happy puzzle solving and I hope you like it!

notes.title: Update 1.02: visual tweak and keyboard support
notes.notes:
Patch notes

    Keyboard control support added
    Visual tweak to easier distinguish between start/finish points


Today I've prepared promised update.

Visual update

First of all the visual difference between start and finish is bigger now so they should be easy to distinguish from afar. Finish is now full circle, manhole cover placed below the color visual. Start is a loop as before.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/25846e2fbf4c6ca3f20aac4bae7b7a09090f6b59.png

Keyboard support
For those uncomfortable with dragging the cars around with your mouse keyboard support was added.

[olist]
    Select the car you want to use with Tab (multiple clicks cycle through available vehicles). Selected car is visualized with big color star on ground
    Move the car using WSAD or arrows (click or hold)
    Dragging any car with mouse deselects keyboard controls, can be reenabled with Tab
[/olist]

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/84f7951877f0ef92d2a4500cc3337ba54e812744.png

I hope you'll find this update helpful and can enjoy the puzzle solving more!

notes.title: Update 1.01, news and future plans
notes.notes:
Update notes
Today I've released a small fix for the game addressing few minor issues with achievements (e.g. Grand master was not being granted).

News
I've also glad to announce that we have first player that beat the campaign on the hard difficulty (timer and night mode)! According to Steam, the play time was around 6 hours so I'm proud to say that singleplayer campaign is as long as in Call of Duty games lately ;).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/46334c9ed19a5b93fc0ee388e22c946100176294.png

Future plans
I'm listening to the feedback from people and please do continue to contact me with your opinions as I'd like to make this game better and more enjoyable for you!

In the next week I'd like to address these things that can be improved or added:

    More visually differentiated start/finish and required points
    Enhanced readability of UI text in levels
    Workshop integration as an alternative for level sharing
    Keyboard/Controller support for car movement


What do you think?

notes.title: Stay tuned for the release coming soon!
notes.notes:
As the release is getting super close and last creases have been polished I'm happy to announce that we are "gold"! All that has to be done is wait for Steam's "Have to be 2 weeks as Coming soon" policy to pass.

I'm really looking forward to what you would think about the game as it is my "baby" :).

If you are eager to test it already or have a lot of commuting to do daily maybe you can consider a mobile version that is already out since yesterday. Just choose your platform:
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/app/car-puzzler/id1334179501

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BorisZapotocky.CarPuzzler

Or you can follow the game on facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/carPuzzler/

In the meantime here is a simple gameplay rules overview:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/5b297b7a39530a590866b0acaac541c7b0f59b7f.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/6fa82d5ed46c075f12e8f3a4ecae8fb9837eb4bc.png
